765030101.text: #Oh ho? Dear {NICKNAME} and Paimon, is that you I spy? Bit of a remote locale for an encounter, I must say.

765030102.text: Hot on the trail of some lead, perhaps? Or might you happen to be lost?

765030105.text: Ah, I see. Indeed, the massive silhouette of the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau has a... peculiar grandeur when viewed from the deck of this wrecked ship — like some slumbering colossus.

765030106.text: Yeah. It's super intimidating, even from way over here. Who knows how many secrets they've squirreled away in there...

765030107.text: I imagine it could be a fine source of inspiration for you, considering your pursuit of unique material in that regard.

765030108.text: After all, the most fascinating tales are often born from the interstice between light and darkness.

765030109.text: Hehehe, with you standing here holding your trusty blue lantern, this place looks like a scene right out of a story already!

765030110.text: Speaking of that, don't you have to man your post at... uh... that place? Are you on leave, or on patrol and stuff?

765030111.text: Both, you could say. We Ratniki keep eternal watch for any calamity that might emerge from the shadows. As such, we must remain vigilant no matter where we are.

765030112.text: That said, things do appear stable around here, so no need to fret over-much. Go about your creative endeavor in peace.

765030401.text: Have you found clarity on how to capture this moment?

765030501.text: We're good. Let the photo-op begin!

765030601.text: One moment. The inspiration's not quite coming yet...

765030701.text: #Why, if it isn't {NICKNAME} and Paimon? Hot on the trail of some lead, perhaps? Or might you happen to be lost?

765030704.text: I see. May this silent colossus provide you with the inspiration you seek, then.

765030705.text: That said, I do not see your Kamera on you. Might you have misplaced it somewhere?

765030801.text: Judging from your expressions, you're still looking for suitable material for your photo-op, yes? Don't worry, you have time aplenty — and many are the true masterworks that found their initial spark from unexpected corners.

765030804.text: It seems you've figured something out. That said, I do not see your Kamera on you. Might you have misplaced it somewhere?
